newsitem.title: USA: Aydin sees more but smaller losses in Q4.
newsitem.headline: Aydin sees more but smaller losses in Q4.

text.p: Aydin Corp said Wednesday that it expects additional but reduced losses in the fourth quarter.
Today it reported third quarter losses of $1.07 per share compared with a year-ago profit of $0.15 per share.

The 1996 third quarter included a pre-tax restructuring charge of $3.7 million. Aydin said third quarter earnings were consistent with management expectations in light of restructuring. Besides anticipating smaller losses in the fourth quarter, the company said its "challenge is to achieve break-even operations by mid 1997."
